test_title: PYST 10: Selection Post (Matric Level) - English Language (Held On 01 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Choose the option that will replace the error highlighted in bold.**

Despite his apology, she refused to accept** his gift and did not **except** his explanation.
solution:
The correct answer is '**1**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"accept"** means to agree to receive or approve something, while **"except"** means to exclude something.
 
• In the given sentence, the first blank refers to the act of agreeing to receive a gift, so **"accept"** is the correct word.
 
• The second blank refers to an explanation being excluded, so the correct word is **"except"**.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Despite his apology, she refused to accept his gift and did not **accept** his explanation."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2:** "except, accept" is incorrect because the first blank needs the word "accept," not "except."
 
• **Option 3:** "accept, except" is incorrect because the second blank needs the word "accept" instead of "except."
 
• **Option 4:** "except, except" is incorrect because both blanks cannot use "except."
